title: UFO Endless Runner — Top-down Style Frames

frames.name: bold-vector
frames.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset: one polished portrait 9:16 style frame for an achievable real mobile endless-runner game, a believable screenshot at ordinary gameplay zoom. Full bleed, no phone bezel, no promotional title.
NONNEGOTIABLE CAMERA: exactly top down, bird's-eye overhead, camera aimed straight vertically at the ground at 90 degrees. Entire frame is a flat playable ground plane. Roofs and tops of UFO/vehicles/people only. No horizon, no sky, no distant mountains, no side view, no isometric view, no elevated diorama camera, no perspective convergence.
GAMEPLAY: player pilots a small UFO upward through an endlessly scrolling Earth landscape. UFO sits around horizontal center, 60 percent down screen, occupies only 9 percent of screen width, so there is lots of visible play space ahead. Its abduction field reads from above as a transparent circular footprint/rings on the ground; one tiny cow and one tiny person are visibly being pulled along curved dotted paths toward the saucer. Never draw a side-view beam cone. At least three additional tiny human targets, two cows, two sheep and one pig are distributed in open terrain ahead. Humans are simple legible overhead heads/shoulders sprites; cows have distinct black-white shapes; sheep and pigs distinct simple silhouettes. Targets collectively occupy under 15 percent of screen. UFO has one small laser targeting an incoming red military missile. A military jeep and tank, seen from directly overhead, enter from the left and upper edges. Red/orange danger indicators, mint/cyan abduction rings and small XP pips distinguish threats and rewards. All game objects remain tiny enough for a workable action game. Clear route options, space between obstacles, visually quiet terrain behind actors. One or two modular roof-view farm buildings and small landscape obstacles establish Earth. Clear screen-edge cropping implies the world scrolls.
HUD: slim safe-area bar at top, compact score "12,480", level "07", mostly-filled XP progress meter, three small shield pips. A lightweight choice strip across only the bottom 14 percent of the image contains exactly three compact upgrade tiles, icons and labels "BEAM", "LASER", "SHIELD". These are a demonstration of the level-up choice state; leave 75 percent or more of the image as readable playable terrain. Match UI to the art style. Do not invent other captions.
PRODUCTION: credible art that a small team could implement with a limited reusable asset kit. Strong visual hierarchy, simple object silhouettes, few materials, modular repeating terrain, no cinematic depth of field, no epic illustration, no hand-crafted photographed set, no huge hero UFO, no busy particles, no soft unreadable details, no branding or watermark. The requested style must change the whole game's shape language and rendering, not only its palette.
ART DIRECTION: bold flat vector sticker arcade. Unusual clean palette of warm ivory farmland, saturated persimmon roofs, cobalt-blue UFO and shrubs, mint beam rings; charcoal outlines. Build actors from 3-5 simple solid shapes with thick dark outlines and one small offset shadow, no gradients or grain. A cheerful precise overhead game with large uncluttered field tiles, rounded dirt paths, circular shrubs and geometric crop rows. Distinctive playful UFO silhouette resembles a cobalt ring with peach center. Crisp scalable 2D vector sprites, polished minimalist mobile-game craft. The three bottom upgrade choices look like slim graphic chips, no large illustrations.

frames.name: bauhaus-pictogram
frames.prompt: Create a single portrait 9:16 GAMEPLAY SCREENSHOT style frame for a real shippable top-down UFO abduction endless-runner on mobile. Extremely distinctive BAUHAUS PICTOGRAM ARCADE art: absolutely flat 2D geometric vector construction, only six opaque solid colors, ZERO shading, ZERO gradients, ZERO realistic materials, ZERO bevels, ZERO cast shadows, ZERO texture. No 3D appearance at all. The visual vocabulary is bold circles, capsules, half-discs, triangles, rectangles, thick ink-black graphic marks. Ground is solid pale pink. Modular navy crop stripe rectangles, cream winding roads, sage circular tree icons, mustard roof-only rectangles with no building walls. Directly overhead like a floor plan. A small cream UFO made of concentric circles with a single vermilion center at lower-middle, at most 8 percent of screen width. Mint broken circular radius on ground. Tiny black-and-white cow overhead pictograms, scalloped sheep, round pink pigs and little people made from one head circle and two shoulder halfcircles scattered across wide empty play field ahead. A cow and human follow two curved dotted mint capture trails to UFO. Small army tank top-view built from black rectangles and orange turret and small military jeep entering at edges. Tiny orange missile caught by a straight mint laser. Fresh ground layout with a diagonal cream path crossing top third, navy striped fields at corners, plenty of empty blush pink throughout. A precise graphic design sense but this is a game screen with many small moving sprites, not a poster. Slim charcoal top HUD: "12,480", "LV 07", mint XP bar, three shield symbols. Bottom 12 percent has three cream rectangular upgrade tiles, single graphic icon each and labels "BEAM", "LASER", "SHIELD". Fully top-down overhead plan view, no horizon, no sky, no perspective, no visible building fronts, no trees with trunks visible. No phone frame or title. Make this unmistakably flat vector pictogram game art that could be built from a simple 2D sprite atlas.
